name: Decorative Image
description: Allow specifying an image as having a decorative, presentation role.
project_description:
The Decorative Images module provides an option to mark images as decorative, displayed with a "presentation" role for assistive technologies. The option can be enabled or disabled per-field, allowing content editors to specify the role of an image where used. It provides a second option to make decorative or alternative text required.

 Features 
 
 Adds a "Decorative" checkbox when uploading or editing an image. 
 Sets appropriate attributes on decorative images. 
 Stores decorative status using Drupal’s key-value storage. 
 
 Accessibility 
 Decorative images may not add meaningful content and may be ignored by screen readers. The module can help content authors follow best practices by marking such images properly to avoid audible clutter. For more details, see the W3C guidelines on decorative images .

 Installation & Usage 
 
 Install and enable the module. 
 Navigate to Manage Form Display for a given entity image field. 
 Enable "Decorative image" in the field widget. 
 Edit an image and check Decorative to set the decorative role.
